note: This addendum supplements (does not replace) diagnostics/stuff_v4/spec_lock.json and diagnostics/location_v3/spec_lock.json. All existing decision rules in those files remain unchanged.

qualified_pitcher_season.2020_scaled: 2020 season scaled by games played ratio (~0.37-0.40), yielding >=111 pitches as equivalent
qualified_pitcher_season.sensitivity_run: 500 pitches (reported separately; not the primary bar)

materiality_floor.description: A difference in out-of-sample R² counts as 'adds' only if ALL of the following hold

stuff_v4_next_season.i_corr_final_model: corr(Stuff+ in S, xFIP in S+1) <= -0.30 (final model, in-sample)
stuff_v4_next_season.i_corr_pitcher_holdout_analog: corr(Stuff+ in S, xFIP in S+1) <= -0.25 (pitcher-holdout analog)
stuff_v4_next_season.ii_incremental_delta_r2: point estimate > 0 in both versions; CI lower bound > 0 for final model

location_v3_next_season.i_corr_final_model: corr(Location+ in S, BB% in S+1) <= -0.20 (final model)
location_v3_next_season.i_corr_pitcher_holdout_analog: corr(Location+ in S, BB% in S+1) <= -0.15 (pitcher-holdout analog)
location_v3_next_season.ii_incremental_delta_r2: point estimate > 0 in both versions; CI lower bound > 0 for final model

blend_decision_rules.controls: log(pitches in S) + starter indicator (>=half appearances are starts)
blend_decision_rules.evaluation: rolling-origin out-of-sample: test pairs 2022→23, 2023→24, 2024→25, 2025→26; train on all earlier pairs; pool OOS predictions; report R² and RMSE; paired pitcher-clustered bootstrap CIs (1000 resamples)
blend_decision_rules.condition_1: M3 beats BOTH M1 and M2 under materiality rule (CI lower bound > 0 AND point estimate >= 0.005)
blend_decision_rules.condition_2: M6 beats M0 under materiality rule

outcomes.A: Both conditions met: blended Pitching+ earns a score (weights from M3 standardized coefficients)
outcomes.B: Only Condition 2 met: axes add beyond last season but blend adds nothing over the better axis — no blended score; headline is Stuff+ × Location+ quadrant view
outcomes.C: Neither condition met: neither axis adds beyond last season — both are descriptive

blend_decision_rules.tunneling_predictive: M8 beats M6 under materiality rule
blend_decision_rules.deception_predictive: M9 beats M6 under materiality rule
